facts.fact: BiFinances says the BCEAO's PI-SPI platform, launched 30 September 2025, runs 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and that on 2 April 2026 the BCEAO counted 80 connected participants including nine e-money institutions.
BiFinances reports Wave announced on 6 November 2026 that its customers in Cote d'Ivoire can use the BCEAO's regional PI-SPI platform from its app; this is a regional system, not PAPSS.

facts.fact: BiFinances says the BCEAO set 30 June 2026 as the deadline for institutions to finish connecting to PI-SPI and provide effective service to customers, and asked those in testing to speed up.
